name: No Quotes
description: UofTCTF 2026 / No Quotes: User-controlled data reaches a database query through string interpolation, dynamic query construction, or a custom sanitizer instead of strict parameter binding. Injection type is SQL Injection. Attack surface: unauthenticated web parameters, login/search forms, JSON bodies, or API query fields that feed database/query logic. Recommended strategy: Baseline of the No_Quotes series. Both credentials are interpolated inside an extra pair of parentheses and only ' and " are blocked. Break out with the closing parenthesis and use quote-free literals (hex, unhexed constants, numeric comparison) to force the row lookup to succeed and land in an authenticated session.
